about: Working out a city's state (specs/city.md). Written by scripts/vectors/city.ts with packages/zu; see vectors/README.md for how to read a case.

cases.name: the city acts at once
cases.about: Records by the city admit a join, appoint and dismiss at once; a role needs a resident.

cases.name: a join admitted by a coordinator
cases.about: An admission by a coordinator in office that lists the join; not by a resident, and not without the join.

cases.name: a join with an invitation's code
cases.about: An invitation opened by an inviter or coordinator in office admits the first join that lists it and carries its secret.

cases.name: leaving ends every role
cases.about: A resident's own record that they leave ends residence and every role at once; a new join starts without roles.

cases.name: curators and inviters by one coordinator
cases.about: One coordinator in office appoints and dismisses curators and inviters at once; others cannot.

cases.name: a coordinator by 1 of 1
cases.about: With one coordinator in office, its vote is n / 2 + 1 = 1 and takes effect at once.

cases.name: a coordinator by 2 of 2
cases.about: With two coordinators in office, the first vote opens a proposal and the second passes it.

cases.name: a coordinator by 2 of 3
cases.about: n is the number in office just before the proposal: a coordinator appointed while it is open does not raise it. A repeated vote and a vote by a resident do not count.

cases.name: a dismissal by 3 of 4
cases.about: With four coordinators in office, a dismissal passes with the third vote.

cases.name: a proposal closes after 14 days
cases.about: A vote whose at is more than 14 days after the proposal's opens a new one instead; a vote exactly 14 days after still counts. One proposal is left open.

cases.name: giving up
cases.about: Anyone gives up a role they hold with their own record, at once; a coordinator's is no vote. Taking a role with one's own record does nothing.

cases.name: records no rule gives effect to
cases.about: Records that stay on the chain and change nothing: a resident appointing, an unknown kind, a record for another city, a vote by a resident, a dismissal from a role not held.

cases.name: a fork
cases.about: Two records list the same record as the one before them: the chain takes the earlier at, then the lower CID, and reports the others as forks. A record that lists only a fork is not on the chain.

cases.name: bodies missing or unparsable
cases.about: A record whose body did not come, is not DRISL, is not a map, or is not a city/role body stays on the chain with no effect.
